flags.why: This body-part term is vulgar in ordinary conversation, so colloquial alone is insufficient ([Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/d%C3%A1i)).
This variant of mày is mainly Southern and needs a regional label ([Vietnamese dialect comparison](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vietnamese_language)).
Giường bị rệp cắn says the bed was bitten by bedbugs, instead of saying it was infested.
flags.fix: Giường có rệp nên tôi bị cắn, ngứa cả đêm. = The bed had bedbugs, so I was bitten and itched all night.

flags.why: The guilty or defensive sense is also widely used outside Central Vietnam ([Rung dictionary](https://www.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/Nh%E1%BB%99t)).
The common meaning scab or crust on healing skin is missing ([Rung dictionary](https://www.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/V%E1%BA%A3y)).
flags.fix: noun | scab; crust on the skin

flags.why: The common noun meaning stripe is missing, so learners cannot interpret uses such as một sọc đỏ ([Rung dictionary](https://www.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/S%E1%BB%8Dc)).
